svg.title: The cost, copied before anything locks
svg.desc: Three square rams stand in wells. The first is up, its top block lit teal: the gain. The second, joined to it by a pipe, has sunk by the same block, left as a dashed outline. The third, the listener's, has been lowered to match, its own missing block dashed in magenta, and a magenta bar has slid over both and holds them down.
